body.name: Anonymous Cat
body.description: ZCAT is a Solana-based meme token launched through StonkFun with a built-in holder reward mechanism. The token has a permanent 3% transfer tax, which is collected from ZCAT trading and transfers. These fees are used to generate rewards in Zcash (ZEC), which are distributed proportionally to eligible ZCAT holders. Rewards are automatically airdropped directly to holder wallets, with no staking, claiming, or wallet connection required. The amount distributed varies based on token activity and is not a fixed or guaranteed yield.
